warnings.message: Bundle size exceeds 160 MB.
Model assets exceed 70 MB.
Draw primitive count exceeds mobile target of 500.
Estimated decoded texture memory exceeds mobile target of 256 MB.
Material count exceeds mobile target of 180.

diagnostics.title: Mirrored node scales detected
diagnostics.message: 5 node(s) use negative scale, which can flip normals, lighting, culling, or navigation surface orientation.
diagnostics.action: Apply transforms and recalculate normals in the source model before exporting the client walkthrough.

diagnostics.title: Suspicious node scales detected
diagnostics.message: 78 node(s) have very large/tiny scale and 9 node(s) have strongly non-uniform scale.
diagnostics.action: Apply object transforms in Blender/CAD before export so camera framing, click targets, lighting, and bounds use stable geometry.

diagnostics.title: Some mesh primitives have no material
diagnostics.message: 2 primitive(s) have no material assignment even though the model defines materials.
diagnostics.action: Assign materials to those meshes in the source model or use Studio Materials only after confirming the plain fallback surfaces are intentional.

diagnostics.title: High draw primitive count
diagnostics.message: 643 draw primitive(s) exceed the mobile target of 500.
diagnostics.action: Run Optimization with the Mobile or Balanced profile and inspect the draw-call join result before client/mobile delivery.

diagnostics.title: Collapsed mesh bounds detected
diagnostics.message: 8 primitive(s) have near-zero POSITION bounds despite containing several vertices.
diagnostics.action: Check whether those meshes are helper geometry or an export issue; collapsed bounds can hide objects from generated views and floor detection.

diagnostics.title: Normal-mapped surfaces are missing tangents
diagnostics.message: 64 primitive(s) use materials with normal maps but do not include TANGENT attributes.
diagnostics.action: Export tangents with the model or regenerate tangents before publishing; affected walls, floors, fabrics, or tiles can look flat, inverted, or seam-heavy in WebGL.

diagnostics.title: Texture UVs missing
diagnostics.message: 67 primitive(s) do not include TEXCOORD_0 attributes even though the model uses images.
diagnostics.action: Unwrap UVs or bake textures into a GLB with valid TEXCOORD_0 attributes.

diagnostics.title: Baked lighting is not linked
diagnostics.message: 192 material(s) are present, but none have linked lightmap textures.
diagnostics.action: Use Bake to generate and review lightmaps before treating the scene as a Shapespark-style client walkthrough.

diagnostics.title: Physical glass/transmission materials detected
diagnostics.message: 3 material(s) use transmission or volume extensions.
diagnostics.action: Compare glass in the viewer after optimization; browser viewers may need simpler glass settings for stable performance.

diagnostics.title: High estimated texture memory
diagnostics.message: 1789 MB estimated decoded RGBA texture memory exceeds the mobile target of 256 MB.
diagnostics.action: Downscale less visible textures, remove unused texture images, or run KTX2/Basis compression before mobile delivery.

diagnostics.title: Model scale normalized
diagnostics.message: The viewer applies a 0.001 scale factor so navigation uses meter-like units.
diagnostics.action: Keep this value unless the model appears too small or too large.

diagnostics.title: No named ceiling or roof meshes found
diagnostics.message: The model may be open at the top, or ceiling geometry may use generic object names.
diagnostics.action: Check the model in top and interior views before client delivery. If ceilings exist but are invisible, enable double-sided materials or rename ceiling/roof objects before import.

diagnostics.title: Walk zones overlap blockers
diagnostics.message: 1 walk zone(s) overlap a wall, boundary, or custom blocker, so users may see valid floor areas that still refuse movement.
diagnostics.action: Shrink or split the block zones around the room floor, or trim the walk zone so the allowed walking area does not sit inside blockers.

diagnostics.title: Walk views are outside walkable zones
diagnostics.message: 4 walk view(s) can load there, but click routing may not continue from that position.
diagnostics.action: Add a walk patch around each view or move the view into an existing walk zone.

diagnostics.title: Geometry compression missing
diagnostics.message: The scene model is large and does not advertise Meshopt or Draco compression.
diagnostics.action: Run optimization before publishing, then keep the optimized model active for web delivery.

diagnostics.title: Texture transfer compression missing
diagnostics.message: The model uses texture images but does not advertise WebP transfer textures or KHR_texture_basisu/KTX2 GPU textures.
diagnostics.action: Run optimization to create WebP transfer textures, then enable KTX2/Basis for production GPU-memory savings.

blockers.title: Large model is not geometry-compressed
blockers.message: The active scene model is over 10 MB and does not advertise Meshopt or Draco compression.
blockers.action: Run the optimizer and keep scene.optimized.glb active before publishing.

warnings.title: Over mobile triangle budget
warnings.message: Triangle count exceeds 15,00,000 triangles.
warnings.action: Simplify meshes or split heavy content before mobile delivery.

warnings.title: High draw primitive count

warnings.action: Run draw-call optimization or merge compatible static primitives before mobile delivery.

warnings.title: High decoded texture memory
warnings.message: Estimated decoded texture memory is 1789 MB, above the 256 MB mobile target.
warnings.action: Downscale large texture sets and run KTX2/Basis texture compression before mobile delivery.

warnings.title: High mesh count
warnings.message: The model is over the mobile mesh-count budget, which can increase draw calls.
warnings.action: Merge static meshes that share materials.

warnings.title: Large initial bundle
warnings.message: The bundle is over the mobile transfer-size target.
warnings.action: Optimize model/textures and lazy-load large media.

warnings.title: No KTX2/Basis texture compression

warnings.action: Install KTX-Software/toktx and run the production texture-compression pass.
